referenceAdaptations: Controlled time (including implicit oscSine time), fixed-pose warm-up, independent seeded RangeNode initialization, Inspector control capture and viewport layout; original scripts and shader expressions.
Soft-particle uniform controls refresh in the render group when parameters change at a fixed time.
The animated FSR1 scene advances once and rewinds before its zero-time measurement. Damped cameras settle before the orbit/pan/wheel images.
limitations: Inspector UI is adapted; hardware CPU/GPU timing parity has not been measured.
MSAA soft-particle depth sampling uses an additional fullscreen depth resolve; Backdrop Area avoids an identical redundant color copy.
Framebuffer sampling currently supports retained two-dimensional targets; color snapshots use nearest sampling and no mip chain.
